node.title: Indicadores de resistencia
node.summary: Operational signals help locate obstacles to a transformation.

relations: The Nestlé account describes how the dashboard, liberation strategy and six-domain root-cause tool were used as a sequence.
La fuente pública es un relato del programa, no una evaluación causal independiente. No llamar Lean, Six Sigma o ensayo controlado a esta secuencia sin evidencia adicional.
Resistance indicators can focus investigation, while capability and critical-path analysis are needed to distinguish a causal bottleneck from a visible symptom.
No identidad entre el dashboard JUBAP y un instrumento validado de causalidad; las seis perspectivas se adaptan al caso.
Tuxpan's adoption layer can be compared with JUBAP's internal facilitation model: the operating practice must become usable and transmissible inside the receiving organization.
La analogía no implica que ambos casos usaran los mismos talleres, secuencia o técnicas de facilitación.
